execution_rules: Before implementing each node, select exact current source bytes and propose its write scope. Code areas here are planning pointers, not blanket mutation authority.
Preserve historical candidate packages and unrelated dirty work; prefer successor artifacts. Shared compiler changes invalidate dependent currentness claims and require fresh tests.
A dependency edge means an upstream interface and its acceptance checks are available, not merely that a task was started.
D02 counterexamples may progress alongside D01. D06/D07/D08 and later D10/D11 can be worked independently when dependencies pass; the graph does not authorize agent fan-out.
Continue dependency-ready local prototype work while unrelated operational support remains deferred.
Do not auto-generate grants, business defaults, destructive mappings or ambiguous identity selections.

open_questions.question: Which current DomainSpec public API owns typed binding-owned system entities for Node and Rust?
open_questions.blocks: Only the selected binding-import implementation if no suitable API exists; definition and fixture work continue.
open_questions.resolution: The previous binding supplied no typed imports. Constructed a versioned local DomainSpec binding-type prototype and Alch resolver; public CLI 1.0.0 validates delivery contracts and generates mappings. Upstream type-profile admission remains separate.

open_questions.question: How should local transport attempts and consumer receive counts map to canonical DomainSpec policy semantics?
open_questions.blocks: Delivery implementation only until semantics are explicit.
open_questions.resolution: Transport leases and authenticated nonduplicate consumer attempts have distinct durable counters. Retention ends delivery eligibility and preserves receipts plus a named local terminal copy.

open_questions.question: Which exact legacy operation-keyed rows can map to one entity or to separate projections?
open_questions.blocks: Only the affected migration; new-root construction continues.
open_questions.resolution: Offline legacy migration requires explicit one-to-one ownership and archives displaced fields. The fresh-root controller derives compatible additive backfills; ambiguous identities and unsafe rollback reject.

completion: All D12 tests pass for exact source/compiled bytes and every finding is closed. Product approval and operational effects remain separate.
